title: Zero-shot Generalizable Graph Anomaly Detection with Mixture of Riemannian Experts
abstract: arXiv:2602.06859v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Graph Anomaly Detection (GAD) aims to identify irregular patterns in graph data, and recent works have explored zero-shot generalist GAD to enable generalization to unseen graph datasets. However, existing zero-shot GAD methods largely ignore intrinsic geometric differences across diverse anomaly patterns, substantially limiting their cross-domain generalization. In this work, we reveal that anomaly detectability is highly dependent on the underlying geometric properties and that embedding graphs from different domains into a single static curvature space can distort the structural signatures of anomalies. To address the challenge that a single curvature space cannot capture geometry-dependent graph anomaly patterns, we propose GAD-MoRE, a novel framework for zero-shot Generalizable Graph Anomaly Detection with a Mixture of Riemannian Experts architecture. translated_title: 基于黎曼专家混合的零样本可泛化图异常检测
translated_abstract: 图异常检测（GAD）旨在识别图数据中的不规则模式，近期的研究探索了零样本通用GAD，以实现对未见过的图数据集的泛化。然而，现有的零样本GAD方法在很大程度上忽略了不同异常模式之间内在的几何差异，这极大地限制了它们的跨域泛化能力。在本工作中，我们揭示了异常的可检测性高度依赖于底层的几何特性，并且将来自不同域的图嵌入到单一的静态曲率空间中会扭曲异常的结构特征。为了解决单一曲率空间无法捕捉依赖于几何特性的图异常模式这一挑战，我们提出了GAD-MoRE，一个采用黎曼专家混合架构的新型零样本可泛化图异常检测框架。具体而言，为了确保每个异常模式都在黎曼空间中得到建模……
tldr: 提出GAD-MoRE框架，通过黎曼专家混合架构解决单一曲率空间无法捕捉不同几何特性异常模式的问题，从而提升零样本图异常检测的跨域泛化能力。
en_tdlr: GAD-MoRE introduces a Mixture of Riemannian Experts architecture for zero-shot graph anomaly detection, overcoming the limitation that a single curvature space cannot capture geometry-dependent anomaly patterns, thereby improving cross-domain generalization.
